				<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-e384f26 elementor-widget elementor-widget-heading" data-id="e384f26" data-element_type="widget" data-e-type="widget" data-widget_type="heading.default">
				<div class="elementor-widget-container">
					<h1 class="elementor-heading-title elementor-size-default">Kitecamp South Africa - Experience the Diversity</h1>				</div>
				</div>
				<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-3603049 elementor-widget-divider--view-line elementor-widget elementor-widget-divider" data-id="3603049" data-element_type="widget" data-e-type="widget" data-widget_type="divider.default">
				<div class="elementor-widget-container">
							<div class="elementor-divider">
			<span class="elementor-divider-separator">
						</span>
		</div>
						</div>
				</div>
				<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-8236b2a elementor-widget elementor-widget-text-editor" data-id="8236b2a" data-element_type="widget" data-e-type="widget" data-widget_type="text-editor.default">
				<div class="elementor-widget-container">
									<p>Langebaan &amp; Cape Town Combined</p>								</div>
				</div>
				<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-15af1da elementor-widget elementor-widget-text-editor" data-id="15af1da" data-element_type="widget" data-e-type="widget" data-widget_type="text-editor.default">
				<div class="elementor-widget-container">
									<p>Shorten the winter and just get out there! The spots around Cape Town and Langebaan are the dream of every kitesurfer – it's no wonder that kite pros train and test on the beaches of South Africa. </p><p>For the current edition of our South Africa Kite Camp, we've combined two destinations into one camp: we'll spend a week in the Langebaan area to get warmed up for the top spots around Cape Town during the second week. The special thing about South Africa is the variety of possibilities, which we will fully exploit.</p>								</div>
				</div>
				<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-7c5584d elementor-widget elementor-widget-text-editor" data-id="7c5584d" data-element_type="widget" data-e-type="widget" data-widget_type="text-editor.default">
				<div class="elementor-widget-container">
									<p>South Africa offers the ultimate all-inclusive package for our kitecamp: Finest flat water and waves with a Woo record guarantee meet consistently strong winds. Add to that the vibrant life and breathtaking landscape that invite extended discovery tours, combined with excellent cuisine for which we have no fitting words beyond “OMG!!!”.</p><p>In short: You simply have to experience South Africa!</p>								</div>
				</div>
				</div>

				<div class="elementor-widget-container">
					<h2 class="elementor-heading-title elementor-size-default">Accommodation in Langebaan and Cape Town</h2>				</div>
				</div>
				<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-16a27bd elementor-widget elementor-widget-text-editor" data-id="16a27bd" data-element_type="widget" data-e-type="widget" data-widget_type="text-editor.default">
				<div class="elementor-widget-container">
									<p>At Kitecamp South Africa, we will stay one week in Langebaan and one week in Cape Town. In both locations, we will be accommodated within walking distance of the beach with a direct view of the water. </p><p>In Langebaan, we live in modern villas from which we overlook the entire Shark Bay lagoon. The villas have kitchens and spacious outdoor areas – what a view! </p><p>It takes us about five minutes to walk from the room to the spot. </p>								</div>
				</div>
				</div>

				<div class="elementor-widget-container">
									<p>In Cape Town, we live in apartments in a hotel complex directly on the white sandy beach of Blouberg, with views of Table Mountain and a guarantee of dreamlike sunsets.</p><p>You don't need two minutes from your room to the beach – it's best to go straight in your wetsuit!</p><p>This accommodation also has kitchens, but we'll hardly cook as there's fantastic food to eat out.</p>								</div>

									<p>Versatility is the name of the game</p>								</div>

				<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-f49bf85 elementor-widget elementor-widget-heading" data-id="f49bf85" data-element_type="widget" data-e-type="widget" data-widget_type="heading.default">
				<div class="elementor-widget-container">
					<h2 class="elementor-heading-title elementor-size-default">Conditions in Langebaan and Cape Town</h2>				</div>
				</div>
				<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-031ae89 elementor-widget elementor-widget-text-editor" data-id="031ae89" data-element_type="widget" data-e-type="widget" data-widget_type="text-editor.default">
				<div class="elementor-widget-container">
									<p>In Langebaan, about 130 km west of Cape Town, the cozier side of South Africa awaits us: fantastic turquoise-blue, seemingly endless shallow water with smaller waves – perfect for acclimatizing, really improving your skills and tricks, and truly enjoying it for the first time. </p><p>In the second week, we're heading to Blouberg near Cape Town. Here, miles of sandy beach and the “Cape Doctor” await us – the warm, constant wind of about 20-45 knots from the southeast, which provides perfect kitesurfing conditions in Cape Town. It's also responsible for the small to quite large waves that are ideal for honing jumping technique and especially jump height, or for kicking it into high gear with strapless riding. </p><p>To participate in the kite camp in South Africa, you must definitely be able to ride upwind reliably (equivalent to VDWS Level 5). You will spend the maximum amount of time on the water and receive continuous tips on how to improve your skills. Additionally, we will host selected workshops on jump techniques, kiteloops, and wave kiting.</p>								</div>
				</div>

				<div class="elementor-widget-container">
									Experience to the fullest								</div>

				<div class="elementor-widget-container">
					<h2 class="elementor-heading-title elementor-size-default">Discover and enjoy South Africa</h2>				</div>
				</div>
				<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-57f80b9 elementor-widget elementor-widget-text-editor" data-id="57f80b9" data-element_type="widget" data-e-type="widget" data-widget_type="text-editor.default">
				<div class="elementor-widget-container">
									<p>While you can slow down in Langebaan, relax in the dreamlike surroundings of the national park, and perfectly concentrate on kiting, Cape Town awaits with diverse opportunities and experiences. </p><p>Cape Town is a melting pot of different cultures, traditions, lifestyles, and cuisines (keyword: OMG-culinary). The area is similarly versatile in terms of activities, with its bays and beaches, surrounding wineries, and mountains like Table Mountain, Lion's Head, or Devil's Peak. </p><p>There is so unbelievably much to discover in South Africa: adventurous excursions, dreamlike beaches, incredibly good food, wine tastings, and much more. Depending on where we want to go, we rent cars or travel very flexibly with Uber.</p>								</div>

				<div class="elementor-widget-container">
					<h2 class="elementor-heading-title elementor-size-default">LakeUnited Supervision</h2>				</div>
				</div>
				<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-d391092 elementor-widget elementor-widget-global elementor-global-36043 elementor-widget-heading" data-id="d391092" data-element_type="widget" data-e-type="widget" data-widget_type="heading.default">
				<div class="elementor-widget-container">
					<h2 class="elementor-heading-title elementor-size-default">The best conditions for your skill boost
</h2>				</div>
				</div>
				<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-988a50c elementor-widget elementor-widget-global elementor-global-35134 elementor-widget-text-editor" data-id="988a50c" data-element_type="widget" data-e-type="widget" data-widget_type="text-editor.default">
				<div class="elementor-widget-container">
									<p>Our highly trained LakeUnited coaches are always on-site at each of our camps. LakeUnited coaches are passionate about your progress. Their years of experience, their keen eye, and their attention to detail will help you improve your kitesurfing skills quickly and easily. <strong>Supervision offers you the space to make progress independently.</strong></p><p class="translation-block">As part of LakeUnited Supervision, we ensure the perfect space and safety at the spot. This enables real progress and the further development of your kite skills. We select the right spot on site, assist you in choosing the right equipment, and give you personalized tips for your individual progress. Depending on the wind and weather, we hold workshops on various topics. Supervision is not coaching or traditional kite lessons.</p><p class="translation-block">We create the framework so you can get the most out of your experience. We share all our knowledge and tricks with you and answer all your questions to help you become a better kiter.</p>								</div>

									<p>We have briefly summarized all the useful information for you.</p>								</div>

												<a class="elementor-toggle-title" tabindex="0">Travel, transfer and transport</a>
					</h5>

					<div id="elementor-tab-content-4911" class="elementor-tab-content elementor-clearfix" data-tab="1" role="region" aria-labelledby="elementor-tab-title-4911"><p>You'd best book a flight to Cape Town. </p><p>Since we have two destinations planned in South Africa, we'll need rental cars at Cape Town airport already. In our WhatsApp group, we're organizing carpools and the joint drive to Langebaan in advance.</p></div>
				</div>
							<div class="elementor-toggle-item">
					<h5 id="elementor-tab-title-4912" class="elementor-tab-title" data-tab="2" role="button" aria-controls="elementor-tab-content-4912" aria-expanded="false">
												<span class="elementor-toggle-icon elementor-toggle-icon-right" aria-hidden="true">
															<span class="elementor-toggle-icon-closed"><i class="fas fa-caret-right"></i></span>
								<span class="elementor-toggle-icon-opened"><i class="elementor-toggle-icon-opened fas fa-caret-up"></i></span>
													</span>
												<a class="elementor-toggle-title" tabindex="0">Catering</a>
					</h5>

					<div id="elementor-tab-content-4912" class="elementor-tab-content elementor-clearfix" data-tab="2" role="region" aria-labelledby="elementor-tab-title-4912"><p>Everyone can customize the meal according to their preferences, which is why catering in the kite camp is not included.</p><p>South Africa has an incredible amount to offer culinarily. Therefore, we will decide together on-site which of the excellent restaurants we will go to.</p><p>Also good to know: South Africa is really inexpensive when it comes to food.</p></div>
				</div>
							<div class="elementor-toggle-item">
					<h5 id="elementor-tab-title-4913" class="elementor-tab-title" data-tab="3" role="button" aria-controls="elementor-tab-content-4913" aria-expanded="false">

															<span class="elementor-toggle-icon-closed"><i class="fas fa-caret-right"></i></span>

													</span>
												<a class="elementor-toggle-title" tabindex="0">Accommodation</a>
					</h5>

					<div id="elementor-tab-content-4913" class="elementor-tab-content elementor-clearfix" data-tab="3" role="region" aria-labelledby="elementor-tab-title-4913"><p>In Langebaan, we live in a small complex with several villas, two of which we will be occupying. Essentially, the rooms are double rooms but have single beds.</p><p>In Cape Town, we are staying at a hotel complex right on the beach with a view of Table Mountain. Apartments for a maximum of 4 people are available here. There is a large double bed (good for couples) and a room with 2 single beds.</p></div>
				</div>
							<div class="elementor-toggle-item">
					<h5 id="elementor-tab-title-4914" class="elementor-tab-title" data-tab="4" role="button" aria-controls="elementor-tab-content-4914" aria-expanded="false">

															<span class="elementor-toggle-icon-closed"><i class="fas fa-caret-right"></i></span>
								<span class="elementor-toggle-icon-opened"><i class="elementor-toggle-icon-opened fas fa-caret-up"></i></span>
													</span>
												<a class="elementor-toggle-title" tabindex="0">Supervision</a>
					</h5>

					<div id="elementor-tab-content-4914" class="elementor-tab-content elementor-clearfix" data-tab="4" role="region" aria-labelledby="elementor-tab-title-4914"><p class="translation-block">Our highly trained LakeUnited coaches are always on site at each of our camps. LakeUnited coaches are passionate about your progress. It's not just years of experience that make up their skills. Their trained eye, attention to detail and precise instructions enable you to <strong>get better at kitesurfing easily and in a short time</strong>.</p><p class="translation-block">As part of <strong>LakeUnited Supervision</strong> we ensure the perfect conditions and safety at the spot. In addition, we enable real progress on the water and the further development of your kite skills. We select the right spot on site, support you in choosing the right equipment and give you personal tips for your individual progress - <strong>so that you can get the most out of it</strong>.</p><p class="translation-block">Depending on the wind and weather, we hold workshops on different topics. <strong>We share all our knowledge and tricks with you and answer all your questions</strong> to make you a better kiter.</p></div>
				</div>
							<div class="elementor-toggle-item">
					<h5 id="elementor-tab-title-4915" class="elementor-tab-title" data-tab="5" role="button" aria-controls="elementor-tab-content-4915" aria-expanded="false">
												<span class="elementor-toggle-icon elementor-toggle-icon-right" aria-hidden="true">
															<span class="elementor-toggle-icon-closed"><i class="fas fa-caret-right"></i></span>
								<span class="elementor-toggle-icon-opened"><i class="elementor-toggle-icon-opened fas fa-caret-up"></i></span>
													</span>
												<a class="elementor-toggle-title" tabindex="0">Kite equipment</a>
					</h5>

					<div id="elementor-tab-content-4915" class="elementor-tab-content elementor-clearfix" data-tab="5" role="region" aria-labelledby="elementor-tab-title-4915"><p>We recommend kites of 5-10 m², maximum 12 m². <span style="font-weight: 400;">When the Cape Doctor blows, 75-80 kg riders sometimes need a 7.</span></p><p>So that you don't just build up your muscles while towing your kite and otherwise sit around waiting for better wind, we also offer you our equipment for rent.</p><p>Whether on land or on the water, strong or weak wind - we always have the right equipment for you! So you travel much more carefree, use a twint tip or a wave board and new kites from top brands like Flysurfer, Core, Ozone or Duotone and have more time on the water overall.</p><p><b>Good to know:</b> Our equipment rental includes kites and boards. If you don't have your own harness or want to rent one, let us know. If you don't have your own wetsuit yet, we will be happy to advise you with buying one or support you with renting on site.</p></div>
				</div>
							<div class="elementor-toggle-item">
					<h5 id="elementor-tab-title-4916" class="elementor-tab-title" data-tab="6" role="button" aria-controls="elementor-tab-content-4916" aria-expanded="false">
												<span class="elementor-toggle-icon elementor-toggle-icon-right" aria-hidden="true">
															<span class="elementor-toggle-icon-closed"><i class="fas fa-caret-right"></i></span>
								<span class="elementor-toggle-icon-opened"><i class="elementor-toggle-icon-opened fas fa-caret-up"></i></span>
													</span>
												<a class="elementor-toggle-title" tabindex="0">Insurance</a>
					</h5>

					<div id="elementor-tab-content-4916" class="elementor-tab-content elementor-clearfix" data-tab="6" role="region" aria-labelledby="elementor-tab-title-4916"><p><strong>Travel insurance:</strong> We're not insurance agents, but we're committed to offering you comprehensive travel insurance. And in truth, cancellation and travel insurance does make sense. You can choose an insurance package when booking.</p><p><strong>Equipment insurance: </strong>With the insurance tool of the Association of German Water Sports Schools (VDWS) you are insured against damage to your own equipment or to the rental equipment. This has often saved us stress, which is why we definitely recommend the VDWS Safety Tool! You can find more information about this <a href="https://www.vdws.de/safetytool/VY99056">https://www.vdws.de/safetytool/VY99056</a></p></div>
				</div>
								</div>
						</div>
				</div>
				</div>
				</div>
				</div>
		
		
			</div>
